description: This file defines a class 'AdoNetClusteringClientOptionsValidator' used to validate configuration options for AdoNet clustering in Orleans. It checks if required properties 'Invariant' and 'ConnectionString' are set, throwing exceptions if they are missing.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringClientOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for AdoNetClusteringClientOptions that ensures required configuration properties are provided.

methods.name: AdoNetClusteringClientOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with the provided options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the options, ensuring 'Invariant' and 'ConnectionString' are not null or whitespace.
